blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Amid reports of farmgate prices dropping to as low as P105 per kilogram in some local government units (LGUs), the Cebu Provincial Government has adopted recommended price benchmarks for live hogs and pork products. The measures, contained in Executive Order (EO) No. 61 signed by Gov. Pamela Baricuatro on Nov. 25, 2026, aim to stabilize the local swine industry and protect the livelihood of hog raisers. The order covers recommended prices for live hogs, piglets, pork carcasses and selected pork cuts, alongside initiatives to prioritize locally produced hogs in the market.
